author: Seung Wook
problem: Dates are (year, month, day) tuples. Return how many full years a member has belonged to a rowing club, from the date they joined until today.
bug_description: Uses <= when comparing (month, day), so on the anniversary itself the year that has just been completed isn't counted.

comments.accurate: Completed years of club membership as of today
comments.wrong_behavior: Completed membership years; a year counts once its anniversary day has passed
comments.wrong_location: Anniversary check verified; check the year difference subtracts the joining year
